note: R6-D: each case settled (an action, where one, at T1 and settled), `pens` = the sorted set of stroke|width|dash|offset|ends of every stroked path under the series views (lineWidth > 0, a stroke not null nor none) -- of the part `part` names where one is (symbol: a radar item's symbols; pointer / progress: a gauge's; ribbon: a chord's links) -- the stroke #rrggbbaa (color.parse), grad a gradient, x:<word> a word that does not parse; the dash normalizeLineDash'd against the width (solid none); the offset 0 where none; the ends cap/join/miterLimit, butt/miter/10 where none. `seen` the paths of that part, `n` the stroked ones.
